name: thimble
description: thimble for Claude Code: Claude adds a citation to each claim you would check in its replies, and a second Claude checks each one against the files when you open it (Citations can check them after each reply instead, or leave citing to you: select words and press w for their source); a click on a citation opens its evidence. Claude draws interactive cards of the data, and v draws one of the last answer. ] and [ step through a reply's citations, explainers and cards in a tray above the prompt; s squeezes or stretches a reply, or catches up on several; after each reply an observer explains terms you may not know, points out important details and keeps the session's claims (c); t lists the side threads asked about a citation, card or pane. Labels sort records into values, and coverage says what Claude read.

citations.title: Citations
citations.description: auto cite + check: Claude cites each claim you would check, and a second Claude checks every citation after each reply. auto cite: Claude cites, and a citation is checked when you open it, which spends fewer tokens. manual: select words in an answer and press w to find where they come from. off: no citations.

cards.title: Cards
cards.description: Claude draws interactive cards, and v draws one of the last answer.

squeeze.title: Squeeze and catch-up
squeeze.description: s makes an answer shorter or longer, and b catches you up on replies you missed. One rewrite each time you ask.

explain.title: Explainers
explain.description: Marks the terms you may not know; ] opens what each one means here. A small part of the call after each reply.

details.title: Heads-ups
details.description: Marks a detail of an answer that is easy to miss and changes what it means; ] opens its heads-up. A small part of the call after each reply.

claims.title: Claims
claims.description: c opens what Claude and you claimed in the session, with why each holds and its sources; the bar counts them. Extract claims says when they are extracted.

claimsMode.title: Extract claims
claimsMode.description: auto: the claims are extracted after each reply, the largest part of the call after it. on demand: when you press f in the Claims pane, which spends fewer tokens.

counts.title: Labels and coverage on the bar
counts.description: The bar shows how much of the data Claude has seen and how many labels there are. No model call: thimble counts the files after each turn.

squeezeCards.title: Squeeze changes cards (experimental)
squeezeCards.description: When s makes an answer much shorter or longer, or writes it for another reader, it may edit, add or leave out a card with the text. 0 brings the cards back as they were. Each rewrite also reads the cards.

marks.title: Citations (old setting)
marks.description: Replaced by Citations, which has its modes.

citationChecks.title: Citation checks (old setting)
citationChecks.description: Replaced by Citations, which has its modes.
